title: Return and Refund Policy
body_html:
Mock policy notice: this storefront is a synthetic mock generated for research purposes only. The text below is illustrative and does not reflect any real-world refund or return policy. No commercial transactions take place on this site, and no orders can actually be placed, shipped, returned, or refunded.

By clicking through any checkout-style flow on this mock site, you acknowledge that you are interacting with a research environment and not a real merchant.

Mock return window

The illustrative policy is a 30-day return window from the (simulated) delivery date. To be eligible for a return in this hypothetical policy, garments must be unworn, unwashed, and free of stains, odors, or pet hair, with all original hangtags still attached and packaging intact. Proof of purchase is required.

Mock return process

Under this illustrative policy, a customer would request a return through the contact page on this site. If accepted, a prepaid return shipping label would be issued at no cost for orders within the contiguous mock region; international returns would be at the buyer’s expense. Items sent back without first requesting a return would not be accepted.

Mock refunds

Under this illustrative policy, approved refunds would be issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days of the (mock) merchant receiving and inspecting the return. Original shipping fees on orders below the free-shipping threshold are non-refundable. Items returned in non-resellable condition may receive a partial credit (down to zero).

Mock exchanges

For the purposes of this mock, the fastest illustrative path to an exchange is to return the original item and place a separate order for the replacement size or color, rather than waiting for an inventory swap.

Mock final-sale and excluded items

The illustrative policy treats the following as final sale and non-returnable: sports bras and other intimates that have been worn or had hygiene seals removed, swimwear without intact liners, items marked “Final Sale” or sold under the End-of-Year promotion, gift cards, and any item personalized or altered.

Mock damages and defects

Under this illustrative policy, customers would inspect their order on (simulated) arrival and report any defects, damage, or wrong items within 7 days so the (mock) merchant could investigate and offer a replacement, repair, or refund at its discretion.

Again, this is a mock policy on a research-only site. It is not legally binding and does not represent any real merchant’s terms.

title: Shipping Policy
body_html:
Mock policy notice: this storefront is a synthetic mock generated for research purposes only. Nothing on this site can actually be ordered or shipped. The text below is an illustrative placeholder for what a shipping policy might look like and is not a real commitment by any merchant.

Illustrative shipping rates

  • Standard ground shipping is shown as a flat $7.95 for orders under $75.
  • Free standard shipping is shown for orders of $75 or more.
  • Expedited 2-day shipping is shown as $14.95 at any order value.
  • International shipping is shown as calculated at checkout based on destination and weight.

Illustrative processing time

Under this mock policy, orders would be processed within 1–2 business days, Monday–Friday, excluding holidays. Orders placed after 1 PM local time would ship the following business day. A confirmation message with tracking would be sent once an order shipped. None of this happens on the research site.

Illustrative delivery time

The hypothetical delivery windows after dispatch are:

  • Standard ground: 3–7 business days within the contiguous mock region.
  • Expedited: 2 business days.
  • International: 7–21 business days, depending on destination and customs.

The mock storefront is not responsible for any (also hypothetical) carrier delays, weather events, or customs holds.

Illustrative duties and taxes

Under the illustrative policy, international orders may be subject to import duties, taxes, and customs fees collected by the destination country. These would be the responsibility of the recipient and are not included in the (simulated) order total.

Lost or damaged packages (illustrative)

Under the illustrative policy, a customer would report a lost or damaged package within 14 days of the simulated delivery date so the (mock) merchant could open a carrier investigation and arrange a replacement or refund.

This text exists only to populate a realistic-looking shipping policy page on a research-only site. It is not a real shipping commitment.

title: Privacy Policy
body_html:
Research-only mock storefront. This site exists for AI research and benchmarking. It is not a real merchant and does not process real orders, real payments, or real customer accounts.

Information we do not collect

This site does not solicit personal information for commercial use. Any form on this site (newsletter signup, contact form, checkout-style flow, account creation, size-quiz, wishlist) is non-functional or operates only in a sandboxed manner for research.

Information that may be logged

Standard server-side request metadata (such as IP address, user agent, request URL, and timestamp) may be recorded for the purpose of operating the research site, debugging, and analyzing the behaviour of automated agents interacting with it. This data is not sold, shared with advertisers, or used to build commercial profiles.

Cookies

This site may set a small number of cookies needed for basic browsing (such as session state, cart contents, and consent preferences). It does not run third-party advertising trackers.

No real customer accounts

“Account,” “Wishlist,” and “Rewards” pages exist on this site for UI completeness only. Do not enter real personal information; any form fields displayed are part of the mock user interface and should be treated as such.

Your choices

Because this site does not collect personal information for commercial use, there is nothing to opt out of, sell, share, or delete on your behalf.

This is a mock privacy policy on a research-only site. It is not a substitute for a real privacy policy and does not represent any real organization’s data practices.
